title: Bridging the Data Gap: Digital Twin as a New Paradigm for AI-based Radio Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.26214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a methodology that places a 3D digital twin (DT) of the environment as the main enabler behind the development of radio sensing at scale. The DT acts as a world model, providing geometry, materials, and transmitter/receiver placements to a ray-tracing engine that generates time-indexed channel impulse responses (CIRs) for large numbers of plausible scenes (moving people and objects, layout variants, seasonal/weather conditions, etc). From these synthetic sequences, we train a sequential neural network that maps CIR time series to spatial occupancy estimates, enabling device-free localization (DFL) without instrumented targets. We posit that sensing is best approached as an environment-conditioned learning problem: rather than seeking a single global model, we advocate training or fine-tuning local models specialized to a site-specific DT. translated_title: 弥合数据鸿沟：数字孪生作为基于人工智能的无线感知新范式
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种方法论，将环境的3D数字孪生（DT）作为大规模无线感知发展的核心使能技术。数字孪生充当世界模型，为光线追踪引擎提供几何结构、材料属性以及发射机/接收机的位置信息，从而为大量合理的场景（如移动的人和物体、布局变体、季节/天气条件等）生成带时间索引的信道脉冲响应（CIR）。基于这些合成数据序列，我们训练了一个序列神经网络，将CIR时间序列映射为空间占用估计，从而实现无需在目标上安装任何设备的无设备定位（DFL）。我们认为无线感知最好被构建为一个以环境为条件的学习问题：与其追求单一的全局模型，我们主张针对特定站点的数字孪生来训练或微调本地化模型。作为首个实验，我们引入了一种新颖的状态空间模型（State Space Model）架构，并对其进行了训练和评估……
tldr: 该论文提出以环境3D数字孪生作为世界模型，通过光线追踪引擎生成大规模合成信道数据来训练神经网络实现无设备定位，并主张采用针对特定站点训练本地化模型的环境条件化学习范式，而非单一全局模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using 3D digital twins as world models to generate large-scale synthetic channel data via ray-tracing for training neural networks that enable device-free localization, advocating an environment-conditioned learning paradigm with site-specific local models rather than a single global model.
